description: Fontaines à eau is a dataset listed in Sedif open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Sedif. Jeu de données présentant les données des fontaines à eau potables installées par le SEDIF. Les données sont mises à jour en continue. Coverage: Île-de-France (Syndicat des eaux d'Île-de-France area). The portal files it under Solidarité. The portal shows 42 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-sedif-portal.
